notes: Input focus unreliability in Proxy Chains rename and Discovery Engine: — the root cause was twofold: (1) the `useEffect` + `setTimeout` focus pattern ran once but was vulnerable to React re-renders that happened after the timeout; (2) parent `mousedown` handlers could steal focus before the browser delivered it to the input. Replaced both with a `ref` callback that fires synchronously on DOM mount, and added `onMouseDown={e => e.stopPropagation()}` directly on the input elements to prevent any parent handler from intercepting focus. | SearXNG JSON API returning blocked/HTML responses: — the HTTP `Accept` header was set to `text/html,...` (for general web scraping), which caused some SearXNG instances to return HTML error pages instead of JSON even when `format=json` was in the URL. The header is now overridden to `application/json, text/plain, /` specifically for SearXNG requests. | SearXNG failure logging: — the "Blocked on SearXNG Discovery" message now includes the HTTP response status and the first 120 characters of the response body, making it possible to diagnose why SearXNG is failing (e.g., 403 vs connection error vs empty response).
